mapper.select: SELECT id, chapter_id, project_id, title, content, word_count, version_no, source, note, created_at FROM story_chapter_version WHERE chapter_id = #{chapterId} ORDER BY version_no DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, chapter_id, project_id, title, content, word_count, version_no, source, note, created_at FROM story_chapter_version WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO story_chapter_version (chapter_id, project_id, title, content, word_count, version_no, source, note, created_at) VALUES (#{chapterId}, #{projectId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{wordCount}, #{versionNo}, #{source}, #{note}, NOW())
